name: BSA M20 / M21
engine: 496 or 591 cc air-cooled side-valve single, magneto
intro: BSA's side-valve workhorses, including the wartime M20. Slow, tough and well understood by the clubs.

B: It runs a magneto. Check the points, the condenser and the slip ring before you blame the carb.
K: The gearbox is separate from the engine and has its own oil. Check and change both, and set the primary chain.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
